description.zh: Ctrl+Alt+滚轮按鼠标所在屏调亮度（可改修饰键；内屏 WMI、外屏 DDC/CI，都不可用时可用软件遮罩模拟），Ctrl+Alt+点击开关暖色滤镜；bright 关键字按显示器逐台调节
description.en: Ctrl+Alt+wheel adjusts the brightness of the display under the pointer (the chord is configurable; WMI for built-in panels, DDC/CI for external, and a software layer when neither answers), Ctrl+Alt+click toggles the warm filter; the bright keyword adjusts per monitor

hint.zh: 留空列出显示器；bright 70 全部设为 70%
hint.en: empty lists monitors; bright 70 sets all to 70%

ai.description: List monitors with their brightness and channel (WMI / DDC/CI), or set brightness when the query is a number 0-100. Actions step the selected monitor's brightness. Read-only until an action runs.

hint.zh: 与滚轮/左键组合使用；只按 Ctrl 的滚轮留给任务栏音量插件，所以别选成纯 Ctrl 之外再加 Shift 之类不常用的组合
hint.en: Held with the wheel or a left click. Ctrl alone belongs to the taskbar volume plugin; avoid unusual chords

hint.zh: 默认只调鼠标所在的那块；选“全部”则一次调所有可调显示器
hint.en: The panel under the pointer by default; "all" changes every adjustable display at once

hint.zh: 点一下再按组合键；留空则不注册。作用于鼠标所在屏幕（或按上一条设置）
hint.en: Click, then press the chord; empty registers nothing. Acts on the pointer's display (or per the setting above)

hint.zh: 显示器走不了 WMI/DDC 时，用半透明遮罩模拟变暗；“总是”会叠加在硬件亮度之上。远程会话由下一项单独控制
hint.en: When WMI/DDC cannot drive a panel, a translucent layer simulates dimming; "always" stacks it on the hardware brightness. Remote sessions are controlled by the next setting

title.zh: 远程会话启用软件模拟
title.en: Enable the layer in remote sessions

hint.zh: 远程桌面里硬件通道全部失效，遮罩是唯一可用的变暗手段，所以默认开启；关闭后远程会话内亮度不可用
hint.en: In a remote session the hardware channels all fail and the layer is the only working dimmer, so this defaults to on; off makes brightness unavailable remotely
0–90, default 60; higher gets closer to black

hint.zh: 首次触发彩蛋后解锁；开启或关闭彩蛋
hint.en: Unlocked after the first trigger; turn the easter egg on or off

hint.zh: 0–100，0 关闭；Ctrl+Alt+点击在开/关间切换
写入 plugins.log：钩子安装、判定坐标与逐屏失败原因；排查用
hint.en: Writes hook installation, gesture coordinates and per-display failures to plugins.log
